note: Fault type to conversion-delta table (docs/PLAN.md section 7). deltaPct is the share of monthly leads the fault is estimated to lose. Every row carries the source it comes from; a record may only show a number that traces to a row here and to the customer's inputs. Rows must be re-checked against their source by the reviewer before a record is sent.

rows.label: Slow page load
rows.basis: Conversion rate falls 4.42% for each added second of load time in the first five seconds.

source.title: Portent, Site Speed is (still) Impacting Your Conversion Rate, 2019

rows.label: Page not built for phones
rows.basis: A 0.1 second faster mobile site lifted retail conversion 8.4%; used here as the per-step cost of a poor mobile experience.

source.title: Deloitte and Google, Milliseconds Make Millions, 2020

rows.label: Missing or empty page title
rows.basis: No conversion delta is claimed: a missing title costs search visibility, which this table does not price.

source.title: Google Search Central, Influence your title links

drift.basis: The 90-day rerun sends one email only when the faults it newly finds cost at least this much per month, by the same costing rows as a record. A below-threshold rerun sends nothing. The number is a floor, not a promise: the reviewer can raise it.
